$comment: Allowed ESLint WARNINGS and eslint-disable SUPPRESSIONS per rule – checked by scripts/lint-ratchet.mjs (`pnpm lint`). Numbers only go down: `pnpm lint --tighten` lowers them after a fix; never raise one to make a new warning or disable pass. An exhaustive-deps finding is a behaviour decision (adding the dependency re-runs the effect): «the latest X without re-running» is useEffectEvent, and a disable that stays says why on its own line (`// eslint-disable-next-line <rule> -- why`).
